name: context-guard
description: Context survival for long sessions — depth gate, checkpoint workflow, session rehydration, and token-spend reporting from the local transcripts (soft dependency: statusline-hub, for exact depth from the sensor record it writes, and the weekly reading for usage-report's share of a week; installing statusline brings it; soft dependency: work-items, whose wi the checkpoint uses to fill items: and write open-item residue when a store exists, skipping both with none).
